description: This file implements core authentication logic for a customer service portal backend, includingPrincipal data class, error handling, API key-based authentication, and authorization enforcement functions.

classes.name: Principal
classes.description: Represents the authenticated principal identity and role (customer or staff).

classes.name: AuthError
classes.description: Custom error class for authentication/authorization errors with HTTP status mapping.

methods.name: auth_exception_response(exc: AuthError)
methods.description: Converts an AuthError to a structured JSON response, standardizing error communication.

methods.name: Optional[Principal] get_principal(x_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-API-Key"))
methods.description: Authenticates request based on X-API-Key header, returning a Principal object or raising AuthError.

methods.name: None require_customer(principal: Optional[Principal])
methods.description: Enforces that the caller is an authenticated 'customer'; raises error otherwise.

methods.name: None require_staff(principal: Optional[Principal])
methods.description: Enforces that the caller is an authenticated 'staff'; raises error otherwise.

methods.name: __init__(self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, http_status: int = status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, http_status: int = status.HT/
ctags.signature: (self, message: str, *, code: Optional[str] = None, http_status: int = status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED)

ctags.name: get_principal
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_principal(x_api_key: Optional[str] = Header(default=None, alias="X-API-Key")) -> O/
